pullNonce.description: v2.1 optional identity for a fresh pull. Retain it unchanged on retries; legacy requests may omit it.

RankingMetric.description: Server-confirmed additive learning points earned in the selected period; no cohort normalization or cap.

PointTotal.description: Nonnegative exact integer decimal string; no business cap, no JS Number coercion.

CatalogMetadata.description: Verified current-version metadata. Unknown values remain null; fields may be absent in pre-projection historical versions.
